changes.en: cropped to the body and converted from the original Analyze format to DICOM; organ and tumor labels registered as segment masks (bone / lung+trachea / organs+tumor); in build 708 the organs and tumor are also registered individually as child segments (9 under contrast: heart, bladder, kidneys, stomach, muscle, spleen, liver, intestine, tumor in red #ff3838; 2 under lung: lung, trachea), so each parent segment's own display is fully subtracted by its children; 3D reconstruction and rendering in this app
changes.ja: 元の Analyze 形式データから体部を切り出して DICOM に変換、臓器＋腫瘍ラベルをセグメントのマスクとして登録（骨／肺＋気管／臓器＋腫瘍の3セグメント）、build 708 の子セグメントで臓器・腫瘍を個別登録（造影領域の子9件：心臓10,646／膀胱1,309／腎臓16,913／胃3,540／筋肉3,960／脾臓7,947／肝臓73,719／腸77,988／腫瘍7,525（赤 #ff3838）、肺の子2件：肺27,055／気管271。親セグメントの表示は子の差し引きで0になる）、本アプリで3D再構成
